TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings a systems-driven delivery approach to Package-IV that is aligned to the C&W Department’s priorities: assured constructability through two monsoon seasons, reliable planning control, and measurable quality in road and bridge works. We are a SECP-incorporated private limited company with Active Taxpayer status and provincial sales tax registrations, established in 2012. [CO-PROFILE] Our infrastructure experience includes multiple road construction deployments for federal and provincial government clients (e.g., CAP-015, CAP-039, CAP-003) and bridge engineering deployments completed through 2025, including an international assignment valued at PKR 200M. [CAP-040][CAP-004][CAP-028]

Differentiators that directly support your methodology, CPM-based program, QA/QC and HSE expectations include:
- Proven management systems: ISO 9001 and CMMI Level 3 to drive disciplined planning, documentation and change control on complex, multi-front works. [CO-PROFILE]
- Delivery leadership capacity: six PMP-certified project managers and four PEC-registered engineers to staff a controlled execution and reporting cadence. [CO-PROFILE]
- Safety-first execution: documented HSE policy, site safety plans on infrastructure deployments, and a zero reportable fatalities record. [CO-PROFILE]
- Bid and cashflow assurance: ability to arrange CDR/bank guarantees up to a PKR 100M facility, supporting the PKR 37M bid security requirement. [CO-PROFILE]

We will also be transparent on mandatory gaps: our library does not yet evidence PEC constructor registration in C-A/C-1, ISO 14001, PKR 1,500M average annual turnover, or three PKR 700M road contracts. [CO-PROFILE] We will address these through a compliant JV/partnering and targeted resourcing to meet the issuer’s eligibility and protected watershed environmental requirements. [CO-PROFILE] Additionally, our library does not evidence a ≥60 m span bridge delivered as prime contractor; we will mitigate this by partnering with a qualified bridge prime and retaining our bridge engineering delivery team to ensure design/temporary works rigor and construction control. [CAP-040][CAP-004][CAP-028]
